summary: Afrobeat: 100–130 BPM interlocking polyrhythm, one-chord vamps, horn riffs, guitar and keys ostinatos
body: Drums: busy interlocking patterns, open hats, shakers, a clave or bell pattern on top.
Harmony: one or two chords for minutes; the parts (guitar, keys, bass) each repeat a short riff that interlocks.
Distinct from Afrobeats (modern West African pop): that is slower (95–110), with a dembow-like kick and log drums.

Apply: pattern/gmd-afrobeat-beat-1 on the drums, then pattern/prog-afrobeat-characteristic-3 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 100–130 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
